subproblems.title: Coefficient-norm properties of covectors (reused accepted rsd_mw_tfa_norm_props)
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let F := Covector (Euclid P) n (continuous alternating n-linear forms on ℝ^P with the operator norm ‖·‖), and let N := covectorEuclideanNorm, i.e. N(α) = (Σ_{I : Fin n → Fin P strictly increasing} α(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(n−1)})²)^{1/2} for the standard orthonormal basis (e_j) of ℝ^P. Then (i) N(α + α') ≤ N(α) + N(α') for all α, α' ∈ F; (ii) N(t·α) = |t|·N(α) for all t ∈ ℝ and α ∈ F; (iii) there is a real C ≥ 0 with N(α) ≤ C·‖α‖ for all α ∈ F; and (iv) N : F → ℝ is continuous.
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), (∀ α α' : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm (α + α') ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α + covectorEuclideanNorm α') ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), covectorEuclideanNorm (t • α) = |t| * covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ (∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ C * ‖α‖) ∧ Continuous (fun α : Covector (Euclid P) n => covectorEuclideanNorm α)
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: supplied proof step 1 (|X(ω)| ≤ M(X)‖ω‖ needs |tα| = |t||α|) and step 2 (continuity of S needs |α| ≤ C‖α‖); Simon Ch. 6, (1.15) and Remark 2.6. This is the comparator-accepted theorem Submission.rsd_mw_tfa_norm_props (DAG node root.regular_set_dense-a1.mass_eq_weight-a1.test_form_approx-a1.norm_props-a1), reused with its identical frozen type; the proof below is the one formalized there.

Notation. e_j := EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ j (j ∈ Fin P) is the standard orthonormal basis of ℝ^P, so ‖e_j‖ = 1. 𝓙 is the finite type of all maps I : Fin n → Fin P. For I ∈ 𝓙 put e_I := (e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(n−1)}). F carries the operator norm ‖·‖ of continuous alternating maps. By definition N(α) = √(Σ_{I∈𝓙} q_I(α)), where q_I(α) := α(e_I)² if I is strictly increasing and q_I(α) := 0 otherwise.

1. (Coefficient vector.) For α ∈ F and I ∈ 𝓙 put c_I(α) := α(e_I) if I is strictly increasing and c_I(α) := 0 otherwise. Then q_I(α) = c_I(α)² for every I. Let v(α) ∈ EuclideanSpace ℝ 𝓙 be the vector with coordinates c_I(α). By EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, N(α) = ‖v(α)‖ for every α. (∗)
2. (Linearity of v.) Evaluation at a fixed tuple is linear in the form, so c_I(α + α') = c_I(α) + c_I(α') and c_I(tα) = t·c_I(α) for every I. Hence v(α + α') = v(α) + v(α') and v(tα) = t·v(α).
3. (Proof of (i).) By (∗), step 2 and the triangle inequality in EuclideanSpace ℝ 𝓙: N(α + α') = ‖v(α) + v(α')‖ ≤ ‖v(α)‖ + ‖v(α')‖ = N(α) + N(α').
4. (Proof of (ii).) N(tα) = ‖t·v(α)‖ = |t|·‖v(α)‖ = |t|·N(α).
5. (Coordinate bound.) For every I, |c_I(α)| ≤ ‖α‖. If I is strictly increasing, the operator-norm bound for continuous alternating maps (ContinuousAlternatingMap.le_opNorm) gives |α(e_I)| ≤ ‖α‖·∏_k ‖e_{I(k)}‖ = ‖α‖. Otherwise c_I(α) = 0.
6. (Proof of (iii).) Put C := √(#𝓙) ≥ 0. By step 5, Σ_I c_I(α)² ≤ #𝓙·‖α‖², so N(α) ≤ √(#𝓙·‖α‖²) = C·‖α‖.
7. (Proof of (iv).) By (i) and N(−β) = N(β) (SimonGMT covectorEuclideanNorm_neg), |N(α) − N(α')| ≤ N(α − α'). With (iii) this is ≤ C·‖α − α'‖. So N is C-Lipschitz (LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul), hence continuous.
Steps 3, 4, 6 and 7 prove (i)–(iv), with C = √(Fintype.card (Fin n → Fin P)) in (iii). ∎
proof_key_steps: Write N(α) = ‖v(α)‖ for the coefficient vector v(α) = (α(e_I) if I is strictly increasing, else 0)_I in EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n → Fin P).
v is additive and ℝ-homogeneous; (i) and (ii) follow from the triangle inequality and homogeneity of the Euclidean norm.
|α(e_I)| ≤ ‖α‖·∏‖e_{I(k)}‖ = ‖α‖, so N(α) ≤ √(card(Fin n → Fin P))·‖α‖, which is (iii).
|N(α) − N(α')| ≤ N(α − α') ≤ C‖α − α'‖, so N is Lipschitz and hence continuous, which is (iv).

subproblems.title: Test-form convergence to 0 gives uniform smallness (reused accepted dpf_pfc_testFormOnConverges_zero_uniform)
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P any set, and (ω_j)_{j∈ℕ} a sequence in 𝒟ⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U n) with TestFormOnConverges ω_j 0. That is, there is a compact K ⊆ U containing tsupport ω_j for every j such that every iterated derivative of ω_j converges uniformly on K to that of 0. Then there is a compact C ⊆ U such that ω_j(x) = 0 for every j and every x ∉ C. Moreover, for every ε > 0 and all sufficiently large j, ‖ω_j(x)‖ ≤ ε for every x ∈ ℝ^P, where ‖·‖ is the operator norm on n-covectors.
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn U n), TestFormOnConverges ωs 0 → ∃ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C ∧ C ⊆ U ∧ (∀ j x, x ∉ C → (ωs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x = 0) ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∀ x, ‖(ωs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x‖ ≤ ε
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: supplied proof step 2 ('if ω_j → 0 in the test-form topology … then sup_x of the operator norm of ω_j(x) tends to 0'); Simon Ch. 6, §1, the topology of 𝒟ⁿ(U), used with derivative order 0. This is the comparator-accepted theorem Submission.dpf_pfc_testFormOnConverges_zero_uniform (DAG node root.minimizing_implies_stationary-a1.diffeo_pushforward-a1.pushforward_current-a1.uniform_small-a1), reused with its identical frozen type; the proof below is the one formalized there. Notation: ω_j(x) := (ωs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x; ‖·‖ is the operator norm on Covector (Euclid P) n.
1. (Unfolding.) By definition of TestFormOnConverges ωs 0 there is a compact C ⊆ U with tsupport ω_j ⊆ C for every j. Moreover, for every k ∈ ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ω_j → iteratedFDeriv ℝ k 0 uniformly on C as j → ∞. Take this C; it gives the first two conjuncts.
2. (Vanishing off C.) If x ∉ C then x ∉ tsupport ω_j, so ω_j(x) = 0 (image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport). This is the third conjunct.
3. (The case k = 0.) The zero test form coerces to the zero form, so iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 0 x = 0. Let ε > 0. Uniform convergence for k = 0 (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff) gives j₀ such that for j ≥ j₀ and x ∈ C, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 ω_j x‖ < ε. Since ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 f x‖ = ‖f(x)‖ (norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero), ‖ω_j(x)‖ < ε ≤ ε there.
4. (Points off C.) For j ≥ j₀ and x ∉ C, step 2 gives ‖ω_j(x)‖ = 0 ≤ ε.
5. (Conclusion.) For every ε > 0, for all sufficiently large j, ‖ω_j(x)‖ ≤ ε for every x. With steps 1–2, C satisfies all four conjuncts. ∎
proof_key_steps: Unfold TestFormOnConverges: a compact C ⊆ U contains every tsupport ω_j and all iterated derivatives converge uniformly on C.
k = 0 and ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 f x‖ = ‖f x‖ give, eventually, ‖ω_j(x)‖ < ε on C.
Combine: eventually ‖ω_j(x)‖ ≤ ε for all x.

subproblems.title: A mass-summable series of currents: the sum current with mass and support bounds
subproblems.statement: Assume (VO): for all P, n ∈ ℕ, every U ⊆ ℝ^P, every S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0. Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and X_r ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (r ∈ ℕ) with Σ_r M(X_r) ≠ ∞ (sum in [0, ∞]). Then there is Y ∈ 𝒟_n(U) such that: (i) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) the real series Σ_r X_r(ω) has sum Y(ω) (HasSum); (ii) M(Y) ≤ Σ_r M(X_r); (iii) spt Y ⊆ closure(⋃_r spt X_r). The notions are as follows. 𝒟_n(U) is GeometricCurrentOn U n and 𝒟ⁿ(U) is TestFormOn U n. M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X) is the supremum of ofReal(X(ω)) over ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ 1 for all x. spt X = U ∖ zeroRegion X, where zeroRegion X is the union of the open W with closure W compact, closure W ⊆ U, and X(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω ⊆ W.
subproblems.lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → ∑' r, (X r).mass ≠ ∞ → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, HasSum (fun r => X r ω) (Y ω)) ∧ Y.mass ≤ ∑' r, (X r).mass ∧ Y.support ⊆ closure (⋃ r, (X r).support)
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: steps 1–4 of the supplied proof (evaluation bound, definition and continuity of S, mass, support), written for an arbitrary open U and degree n. The selected statement uses U = ℝ^P (univ) and n = k + 1. This is Simon Ch. 6, 2.4, and the M-absolutely convergent series in the proof of 7.2.

Notation. |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α (Euclidean coefficient norm); ‖α‖ is the operator norm. For Z ∈ 𝒟_n(U), M(Z) = Z.mass = M_U(Z) = sup{ofReal(Z(ω)) : ω admissible}. Here ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) is admissible if |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for every x; tsupport ω ⊆ U holds for every test form in U. Write M(Z)^ℝ := M(Z).toReal.

1. (Norm facts; sibling norm_props.) |tα| = |t||α| for t ∈ ℝ; there is C ≥ 0 with |α| ≤ C‖α‖ for every covector α; and α ↦ |α| is continuous.
2. (Bounded coefficient norm.) Let ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). The function x ↦ |ω(x)| is continuous: ω is C^∞, hence continuous, and step 1 applies. It vanishes outside the compact set tsupport ω, since |0| = 0. So it is bounded; choose c_ω > 0 with |ω(x)| ≤ c_ω for all x.
3. (Evaluation bound.) Let Z ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with M(Z) < ∞, ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U), and c > 0 with |ω(x)| ≤ c for all x. Then |Z(ω)| ≤ c·M(Z)^ℝ. Indeed, for s = c⁻¹ and s = −c⁻¹ the form sω lies in 𝒟ⁿ(U), and |sω(x)| = c⁻¹|ω(x)| ≤ 1 by step 1. So sω is admissible and ofReal(Z(sω)) ≤ M(Z) (GeometricCurrentOn.le_massOn). Since M(Z) < ∞, this means s·Z(ω) = Z(sω) ≤ M(Z)^ℝ. Multiplying the two inequalities by c > 0 gives ±Z(ω) ≤ c·M(Z)^ℝ.
4. (Absolute summability.) Put A := Σ_r M(X_r) < ∞. Every M(X_r) is finite (ENNReal.ne_top_of_tsum_ne_top). The real sequence (M(X_r)^ℝ) is summable (ENNReal.summable_toReal) with Σ_r M(X_r)^ℝ = A^ℝ (ENNReal.tsum_toReal_eq). For ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U), steps 2–3 give |X_r(ω)| ≤ c_ω·M(X_r)^ℝ for every r. So Σ_r |X_r(ω)| < ∞, and the real series Σ_r X_r(ω) is summable (Summable.of_norm_bounded).
5. (Linear functional.) Put L(ω) := Σ_r X_r(ω). Since each X_r is linear and the series are summable, L(ω + ω') = L(ω) + L(ω') (Summable.tsum_add) and L(tω) = t·L(ω) (tsum_mul_left).

Then for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ B there is a linear subspace Q of ℝ^P such that C has approximate tangent space Q at x (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C x Q) and ξ(x) is a unit orientation of Q (IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ(x)) Q).

subproblems.title: Two unit orientations of the same plane differ by a sign (reused accepted rsdic_unitOrientation_eq_or_eq_neg)
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P, and v, w ∈ Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n: continuous linear functionals on n-covectors) with IsUnitOrientationOf v Q and IsUnitOrientationOf w Q. That is, each of v and w is ±(α ↦ α(τ)) for some orthonormal family τ : Fin n → ℝ^P spanning Q. Then w = v or w = −v.
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (v w : MultiVector P n) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), IsUnitOrientationOf v Q → IsUnitOrientationOf w Q → w = v ∨ w = -v

Source: (L3) in step (5d) of the supplied proof (two orthonormal bases of Q differ by an orthogonal matrix of determinant ±1). This is the comparator-accepted theorem Submission.rsdic_unitOrientation_eq_or_eq_neg (DAG node root.regular_set_dense-a1.integer_combination-a1.orientation_sign-a1), reused with its identical frozen type; the proof below is the one formalized there.
1. (Unfolding the hypotheses.) There are orthonormal families τ, τ' : Fin n → ℝ^P with span(range τ) = Q = span(range τ'). There are signs ε, ε' ∈ {1, −1} with v(α) = ε·α(τ) and w(α) = ε'·α(τ') for every n-covector α.
2. Each τ_i and τ'_i lies in Q, so τ and τ' are orthonormal families in the inner product space Q. Since τ is linearly independent and spans Q, dim Q = n. An orthonormal family of n vectors in the n-dimensional space Q is a basis of Q. Hence τ and τ' are orthonormal bases b and b' of Q indexed by Fin n.
3. Let d := det_b(b'), the determinant of the change-of-basis matrix from b to b'. Both bases are orthonormal, so this matrix is orthogonal and d ∈ {1, −1} (Mathlib OrthonormalBasis.det_to_matrix_orthonormalBasis_real).
4. Let α be an n-covector and α_Q its restriction to Q, an alternating n-linear form on the n-dimensional space Q. Every such form is a multiple of det_b: α_Q = α_Q(b)·det_b (AlternatingMap.eq_smul_basis_det). Evaluating at b' gives α(τ') = α_Q(b') = α_Q(b)·det_b(b') = d·α(τ). The number d does not depend on α.
5. Hence for every α: w(α) = ε'·α(τ') = ε'd·α(τ) = (εε'd)·(ε·α(τ)) = s·v(α), where s := εε'd ∈ {1, −1} (using ε² = 1). Therefore w = s·v, i.e. w = v if s = 1 and w = −v if s = −1. For n = 0 the same argument applies: τ = τ' is the empty family, Q = {0} and d = 1. ∎
proof_key_steps: Both orthonormal families spanning Q are orthonormal bases b, b' of Q.
det_b(b') = ±1 because the change-of-basis matrix is orthogonal.
For every n-covector α, α(τ') = det_b(b')·α(τ), since alternating n-forms on Q are multiples of det_b.
Therefore w = (εε'det_b(b'))·v with εε'det_b(b') ∈ {±1}.

Source: this is (IMC)(a) of the selected statement with the two sides of the equivalence swapped. It is used in (5c) and (5g) of the supplied proof. It is Simon Ch. 3, Remarks 1.5(2) and 1.8(1), with the density theorem of Ch. 1, 3.16. This is the comparator-accepted theorem Submission.rsdic_ae_tangent_iff_of_subset (DAG node root.regular_set_dense-a1.integer_combination-a1.tangent_locality-a1), reused with its identical frozen type. The proof below is the one formalized there, with its growth lemma (the accepted Submission.rsdic_measure_closedBall_le_of_tangent) written out in step 5. Notation: μ := Hⁿ = μHE[n]; B̄_r(z) and B_r(z) are the closed and open balls; for ρ > 0, η_ρ(y) := ρ⁻¹(y − x) (blowUpMap x ρ).
1. (Countable compact cover.) Let 𝒟 ⊆ ℝ^P be countable and dense, and 𝒥 := {(c, r) ∈ 𝒟 × ℚ : r > 0, B̄_r(c) ⊆ U}, a countable set. For j = (c, r) put K_j := B̄_r(c), a compact subset of U. Every y ∈ U lies in B_r(c) for some (c, r) ∈ 𝒥. Indeed, choose ε > 0 with B̄_ε(y) ⊆ U, c ∈ 𝒟 with |y − c| < ε/3, and rational r ∈ (ε/3, 2ε/3). Then |y − c| < r and B̄_r(c) ⊆ B̄_ε(y) ⊆ U.
2. (Density theorem.) For j ∈ 𝒥, λ_j := μ⌞(B ∩ K_j) is a finite Borel measure, since μ(B ∩ K_j) < ∞. Apply Besicovitch's density theorem (Mathlib Besicovitch.ae_tendsto_measure_inter_div) to λ_j and A. For λ_j⌞A-a.e. x, λ_j(A ∩ B̄_ρ(x))/λ_j(B̄_ρ(x)) → 1 as ρ ↓ 0. Since A ⊆ B, λ_j⌞A = μ⌞(A ∩ K_j). So there is a μ-null set N_j such that the convergence holds at every x ∈ (A ∩ K_j) ∖ N_j. Then N := ⋃_j N_j is μ-null.
3. (Local notation.) Fix x ∈ A ∖ N. Take j = (c, r) ∈ 𝒥 with x ∈ B_r(c), and δ₀ := (r − |x − c|)/2 > 0, so B̄_{δ₀}(x) ⊆ K_j. For 0 < ρ ≤ δ₀ and Z ⊆ B, λ_j(Z ∩ B̄_ρ(x)) = μ(Z ∩ B̄_ρ(x)). Write a(ρ) := μ(B ∩ B̄_ρ(x)) and b(ρ) := μ(A ∩ B̄_ρ(x)). Both are finite for ρ ≤ δ₀, and b(ρ)/a(ρ) → 1.
4. (Small excess.) For each ε ∈ (0, 1) there is ρ_ε ∈ (0, δ₀] with μ((B ∖ A) ∩ B̄_ρ(x)) ≤ ε·a(ρ) for 0 < ρ < ρ_ε. Indeed, choose ρ_ε with b/a > 1 − ε there. Then a(ρ) > 0 and b ≥ (1 − ε)a. Since A ⊆ B and everything is finite, μ((B ∖ A) ∩ B̄_ρ(x)) = a − b ≤ εa.
5. (Growth.) Suppose D ∈ {A, B} has an approximate tangent space Q at x. D is Borel and μ(D ∩ B̄_{δ₀}(x)) ≤ a(δ₀) < ∞.
   - Scaling: μ is translation invariant and μ(cW) = |c|ⁿμ(W) (Measure.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_smul₀). Also η_ρ(Z) ∩ B̄_R(0) = η_ρ(Z ∩ B̄_{Rρ}(x)). Hence μ(η_ρ(Z) ∩ B̄_R(0)) = ρ^{−n} μ(Z ∩ B̄_{Rρ}(x)) for all Z and ρ, R > 0.
   - Test function: f(y) := max(0, min(1, 2 − |y|)) lies in C_c(ℝ^P, ℝ) and satisfies 1_{B̄_1(0)} ≤ f ≤ 1_{B̄_2(0)}. For 0 < ρ ≤ δ₀/2, f is integrable on η_ρ(D), and ∫_{η_ρ(D)} f dμ ≥ μ(η_ρ(D) ∩ B̄_1(0)) = ρ^{−n} μ(D ∩ B̄_ρ(x)).
   - Limit: by Definition 1.4, ∫_{η_ρ(D)} f dμ → L := ∫_Q f dμ as ρ ↓ 0. So there is r₁ > 0 with μ(D ∩ B̄_ρ(x)) ≤ (L + 1)ρⁿ for 0 < ρ < r₁. Put K₀ := max(L + 1, 0).
   - Case D = B: a(ρ) ≤ K₀ρⁿ for 0 < ρ < r₁.
   - Case D = A: for 0 < ρ < min(r₁, ρ_{1/2}), a(ρ) = b(ρ) + μ((B ∖ A) ∩ B̄_ρ(x)) ≤ K₀ρⁿ + a(ρ)/2. Hence a(ρ) ≤ 2K₀ρⁿ.
   In both cases a(ρ) ≤ Kρⁿ for 0 < ρ < r₂, with some K ≥ 0 and r₂ > 0. With step 4 this gives (†) ρ^{−n} μ((B ∖ A) ∩ B̄_ρ(x)) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0.
6. (Comparison of blow-ups.) Assume (†). Let g ∈ C_c(ℝ^P, ℝ), R ≥ 1 with g = 0 outside B̄_R(0), and M_g := sup|g|. For 0 < ρ < δ₀/R, μ(η_ρ(B) ∩ B̄_R(0)) = ρ^{−n} a(Rρ) < ∞. So g is integrable on η_ρ(B) and on its Borel subsets η_ρ(A) and η_ρ(B ∖ A). Since η_ρ is injective, ∫_{η_ρ(B)} g − ∫_{η_ρ(A)} g = ∫_{η_ρ(B∖A)} g. Its absolute value is at most M_g ρ^{−n} μ((B ∖ A) ∩ B̄_{Rρ}(x)) = M_g Rⁿ (Rρ)^{−n} μ((B ∖ A) ∩ B̄_{Rρ}(x)), which tends to 0 by (†).
7. (Conclusion.) Let x ∈ A ∖ N and Q a subspace. If HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q, then dim Q = n, step 5 applies with D = B, and step 6 gives ∫_{η_ρ(A)} g dμ → ∫_Q g dμ for every g. Hence HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q. Conversely, step 5 with D = A and step 6 give HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q. The null set N does not depend on Q and μ⌞A(N) = 0, so the equivalence holds for μ⌞A-a.e. x and all Q simultaneously. For n = 0 the argument is unchanged. ∎
proof_key_steps: Cover U by countably many compact balls K_j ⊆ U whose interiors cover U.
Besicovitch density theorem for the finite measures Hⁿ⌞(B ∩ K_j): Hⁿ(A ∩ B̄_ρ(x))/Hⁿ(B ∩ B̄_ρ(x)) → 1 for a.e. x ∈ A.
If A or B has a tangent plane at x, the scaling and test-function argument gives Hⁿ(B ∩ B̄_ρ(x)) = O(ρⁿ), so Hⁿ((B ∖ A) ∩ B̄_ρ(x)) = o(ρⁿ).
Then |∫_{η_ρ(B)} g − ∫_{η_ρ(A)} g| → 0 for every g ∈ C_c, so the limits in Definition 1.4 coincide.

subproblems.title: A unit orientation has operator norm at most one (reused accepted unit_orientation_norm_le_one)
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P, and ξ ∈ Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n, the continuous dual of the n-covectors with the operator norm) with IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q. Then ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1.
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ : MultiVector P n), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: the domination |ξ_i(x)(ω(x))| ≤ ‖ω‖ in step (5f) of the supplied proof, in its operator-norm form. This is the comparator-accepted theorem Submission.unit_orientation_norm_le_one (DAG node root.half_space_cone_lies_in_boundary-a1.imrep_measure_unique-a1.orientation_norm_bound-a1), reused with its identical frozen type; the proof below is the one formalized there. Covectors carry the operator norm of continuous alternating maps; MultiVector P n is their continuous dual with the operator norm.
1. By IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q choose an orthonormal family τ = (τ_1, …, τ_n). Either ξ(α) = α(τ_1, …, τ_n) for every n-covector α, or ξ(α) = −α(τ_1, …, τ_n) for every α. That τ spans Q is not used.
2. Fix α. By the multilinear operator-norm bound (ContinuousAlternatingMap.le_opNorm), |α(τ)| ≤ ‖α‖·∏_i ‖τ_i‖. Orthonormality gives ‖τ_i‖ = 1, so the product is 1 (the empty product for n = 0). Hence |α(τ)| ≤ ‖α‖.
3. In either sign case, |ξ(α)| = |α(τ)| ≤ 1·‖α‖.
4. Step 3 holds for every α, and 1 ≥ 0, so ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound gives ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1. ∎
Lean (the accepted implementation): rintro P n Q ξ ⟨τ, hτ, -, hξ⟩; refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one fun α => ?_; have hbound : ‖α τ‖ ≤ ‖α‖ := by simpa [hτ.1] using α.le_opNorm τ; rcases hξ with h | h; · rw [h, one_mul]; exact hbound; · rw [h, norm_neg, one_mul]; exact hbound.
proof_key_steps: Unpack IsUnitOrientationOf: ξ(α) = ±α(τ) for an orthonormal family τ.
|α(τ)| ≤ ‖α‖·∏‖τ_i‖ = ‖α‖ by the multilinear operator-norm bound.
Hence |ξ(α)| ≤ ‖α‖ for all α, so ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1 (opNorm_le_bound).

subproblems.title: A common Borel reference orientation for countably many IMReps
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and R_i = (M_i, θ_i, ξ_i) (i ∈ ℕ) IMReps in U. Put N := ⋃_i M_i and assume Hⁿ(N ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U. Then there are a strongly measurable η : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n) and measurable s_i : ℝ^P → ℝ (i ∈ ℕ) with s_i(x) ∈ {1, −1} for all i and x, such that: (a) for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ N there is a linear subspace Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x Q and IsUnitOrientationOf (η(x)) Q; (b) for every i, ξ_i(x) = s_i(x)·η(x) for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M_i.
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : ℕ → IMRep U n), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] ((⋃ i, (R i).carrier) ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∃ (η : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (s : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ), StronglyMeasurable η ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (s i)) ∧ (∀ i x, s i x = 1 ∨ s i x = -1) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (⋃ i, (R i).carrier)), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (⋃ i, (R i).carrier) x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (η x) Q) ∧ ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R i).carrier), (R i).orient x = s i x • η x
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: steps (5c) and (5d) of the supplied proof. These are the Borel modification of the ξ_i, the common approximate tangent space Q(x) of N, the reference orientation η(x) := ξ_{ι(x)}(x) with ι(x) := min{i : x ∈ M_i}, and the signs s_i. Here (IMC)(a) combined with the orientation field is the reused sibling tangent_transfer, and (L3) is the reused sibling orientation_sign. Stated for an arbitrary open U and degree n.

Notation: μ := Hⁿ = μHE[n]; M_i := R_i.carrier, ξ_i := R_i.orient, N := ⋃_i M_i.

1. (Sets.) Each M_i is Borel and M_i ⊆ U (IMRep fields), so N is Borel and N ⊆ U.
2. (Borel versions.) ξ_i is a.e. strongly measurable for μ⌞M_i. Let ξ'_i := AEStronglyMeasurable.mk ξ_i: ξ'_i is strongly measurable and ξ'_i = ξ_i μ-a.e. on M_i.
3. (Disjoint pieces.) D_i := M_i ∖ ⋃_{j<i} M_j (Mathlib disjointed). The D_i are Borel and pairwise disjoint, D_i ⊆ M_i, and ⋃_i D_i = N.
4. (Reference orientation.) η(x) := Σ'_i 1_{D_i}(x)·ξ'_i(x). At most one term is nonzero, so η = ξ'_j on D_j (tsum_eq_single) and η = 0 off N. For x ∈ N with ι(x) = min{i : x ∈ M_i}, x ∈ D_{ι(x)} and η(x) = ξ'_{ι(x)}(x). η is strongly measurable. Define g_0 := 0 and g_{k+1}(x) := ξ'_k(x) if x ∈ D_k and g_k(x) otherwise. Each g_k is strongly measurable (piecewise definition on a Borel set). If x ∈ D_j, then g_k(x) = ξ'_j(x) = η(x) for all k > j. If x ∉ N, then g_k(x) = 0 = η(x) for all k. So g_k → η pointwise, and η is strongly measurable as a pointwise limit of strongly measurable functions into the metrizable space MultiVector P n (stronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto).
5. (Signs.) s_i(x) := 1 if ξ'_i(x) = η(x) and s_i(x) := −1 otherwise. The set {ξ'_i = η} is Borel, being the equality set of two strongly measurable maps into a metrizable space (StronglyMeasurable.measurableSet_eq_fun). So s_i is measurable and takes only the values ±1.
6. (Tangent planes along N.) Fix j. Apply tangent_transfer to R_j with B := M_j and C := N. Its hypotheses hold: M_j and N are Borel, M_j ⊆ M_j, M_j ⊆ N ⊆ U, and N is locally finite by hypothesis. So for μ-a.e. x ∈ M_j there is Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x Q and IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ_j(x)) Q. Since ξ'_j = ξ_j a.e. on M_j, also IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ'_j(x)) Q a.e. on M_j. As M_j is Borel, this reads: for μ⌞N-a.e. x, x ∈ M_j implies that statement (ae_restrict_iff'). By countability (ae_all_iff), for μ⌞N-a.e. x: for every j with x ∈ M_j there is Q_j with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x Q_j and IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ'_j(x)) Q_j. (†)
7. (Signs a.e. on N.) Let x ∈ N satisfy (†). Then x ∈ D_j for some j (step 3), hence x ∈ M_j and η(x) = ξ'_j(x). So (†) gives Q_j with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x Q_j and IsUnitOrientationOf (η(x)) Q_j; this is conclusion (a) at x. Let i be any index with x ∈ M_i. By (†), Q_i is also an approximate tangent space of N at x, so Q_i = Q_j (SimonGMT HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt.unique). Thus η(x) and ξ'_i(x) are unit orientations of the same Q_j, and orientation_sign gives ξ'_i(x) = η(x) or ξ'_i(x) = −η(x). Hence for μ⌞N-a.e. x, (a) holds and ξ'_i(x) = ±η(x) for every i with x ∈ M_i.
8. (Conclusion (b).) Fix i. Since M_i ⊆ N, μ⌞M_i-a.e. statements follow from μ⌞N-a.e. ones (ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset). So for μ-a.e. x ∈ M_i both ξ_i(x) = ξ'_i(x) and ξ'_i(x) = ±η(x) hold. If ξ'_i(x) = η(x), then s_i(x) = 1 and ξ_i(x) = η(x) = 1·η(x). Otherwise ξ'_i(x) ≠ η(x), so ξ'_i(x) = −η(x) and s_i(x) = −1; then ξ_i(x) = −η(x) = (−1)·η(x) (neg_one_smul). Together with steps 4, 5 and 7, all conclusions hold. ∎

theorem Submission.cmcdt_ims_common_orientation : ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : ℕ → IMRep U n), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] ((⋃ i, (R i).carrier) ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∃ (η : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (s : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ), StronglyMeasurable η ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (s i)) ∧ (∀ i x, s i x = 1 ∨ s i x = -1) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (⋃ i, (R i).carrier)), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (⋃ i, (R i).carrier) x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (η x) Q) ∧ ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R i).carrier), (R i).orient x = s i x • η x := by
  intro P n U R hU hfin
  classical
  set M : ℕ → Set (Euclid P) := fun i => (R i).carrier with hMdef
  set N : Set (Euclid P) := ⋃ i, M i with hNdef
  have hMmeas : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (M i) := fun i => (R i).measurableSet_carrier
  have hNmeas : MeasurableSet N := MeasurableSet.iUnion hMmeas
  have hNU : N ⊆ U := iUnion_subset fun i => (R i).carrier_subset
  -- Borel versions of the orientations
  set ξ' : ℕ → Euclid P → MultiVector P n := fun i => (R i).aestronglyMeasurable_orient.mk (R i).orient
  have hξ'sm : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (ξ' i) := fun i => (R i).aestronglyMeasurable_orient.stronglyMeasurable_mk
  have hξ'ae : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (M i)), (R i).orient x = ξ' i x :=
    fun i => (R i).aestronglyMeasurable_orient.ae_eq_mk
  -- the disjoint pieces
  set D : ℕ → Set (Euclid P) := disjointed M with hDdef
  have hDmeas : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (D i) := MeasurableSet.disjointed hMmeas
  have hDsub : ∀ i, D i ⊆ M i := disjointed_subset M
  have hDdisj : Pairwise (Disjoint on D) := disjoint_disjointed M
  have hDunion : ⋃ i, D i = N := iUnion_disjointed
  -- the reference orientation
  set η : Euclid P → MultiVector P n := fun x => ∑' i, (D i).indicator (ξ' i) x with hηdef
  have hη_eq : ∀ j x, x ∈ D j → η x = ξ' j x := by
    intro j x hx
    simp only [hηdef]
    rw [tsum_eq_single j]
    · exact indicator_of_mem hx _
    · intro i hij
      have : x ∉ D i := fun hxi => (hDdisj hij).ne_of_mem hxi hx rfl
      exact indicator_of_notMem this _
  haveI hmetr : TopologicalSpace.MetrizableSpace (MultiVector P n) :=
    { toPseudoMetrizableSpace := ⟨⟨PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace, rfl,
        Metric.uniformity_basis_dist_inv_nat_succ.isCountablyGenerated⟩⟩
      toT0Space := inferInstance }
  have hη_zero : ∀ x, (∀ i, x ∉ D i) → η x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [hηdef]
    have h0 : ∀ i, (D i).indicator (ξ' i) x = 0 := fun i => indicator_of_notMem (hx i) _
    simp [h0]
  -- finite-stage approximants, built with `ite` only
  let g : ℕ → Euclid P → MultiVector P n := fun k => Nat.rec (fun _ => 0)
    (fun j gj => fun x => if x ∈ D j then ξ' j x else gj x) k
  have hg_succ : ∀ k x, g (k + 1) x = if x ∈ D k then ξ' k x else g k x := fun k x => rfl
  have hg_sm : ∀ k, StronglyMeasurable (g k) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact stronglyMeasurable_const
    | succ k ih =>
      have : g (k + 1) = fun x => if x ∈ D k then ξ' k x else g k x := funext (hg_succ k)
      rw [this]
      exact StronglyMeasurable.ite (hDmeas k) (hξ'sm k) ih
  have hg_eq : ∀ k x, (∀ i, i < k → x ∉ D i) → g k x = 0 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro x _; rfl
    | succ k ih =>
      intro x hx
      rw [hg_succ, if_neg (hx k (Nat.lt_succ_self k))]
      exact ih x fun i hi => hx i (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hi)
  have hg_mem : ∀ j x, x ∈ D j → ∀ k, j < k → g k x = ξ' j x := by
    intro j x hj k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro h; omega
    | succ k ih =>
      intro hk
      rw [hg_succ]
      by_cases hjk : j = k
      · subst hjk; rw [if_pos hj]
      · have hxk : x ∉ D k := fun hxk => (hDdisj (Ne.symm hjk) ).ne_of_mem hxk hj rfl
        rw [if_neg hxk]
        exact ih (by omega)
  have hη_sm : StronglyMeasurable η := by
    refine stronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto atTop hg_sm ?_
    rw [tendsto_pi_nhds]
    intro x
    by_cases hx : ∃ j, x ∈ D j
    · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hx
      apply tendsto_atTop_of_eventually_const (i₀ := j + 1)
      intro k hk
      rw [hη_eq j x hj]
      exact hg_mem j x hj k (by omega)
    · push_neg at hx
      rw [hη_zero x hx]
      apply tendsto_atTop_of_eventually_const (i₀ := 0)
      intro k _
      exact hg_eq k x fun i _ => hx i
  -- signs
  set s : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ := fun i x => if ξ' i x = η x then 1 else -1 with hsdef
  have hs_meas : ∀ i, Measurable (s i) := by
    intro i
    exact Measurable.ite ((hξ'sm i).measurableSet_eq_fun hη_sm) measurable_const measurable_const
  have hs_val : ∀ i x, s i x = 1 ∨ s i x = -1 := by
    intro i x
    simp only [hsdef]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  -- tangent planes along N, for each piece
  have hP : ∀ j, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (M j)), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P),
      HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ' j x) Q := by
    intro j
    have h1 := Submission.rsdic_imrep_ae_tangent_orient_of_subset P n U (M j) N (R j) hU (hMmeas j) hNmeas subset_rfl (subset_iUnion M j) hNU hfin
    filter_upwards [h1, hξ'ae j] with x hx1 hx2
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ1, hQ2⟩ := hx1
    exact ⟨Q, hQ1, hx2 ▸ hQ2⟩
  have hPN : ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict N), ∀ j, x ∈ M j → ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P),
      HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ' j x) Q := by
    rw [ae_all_iff]
    intro j
    have := (ae_restrict_iff' (hMmeas j)).mp (hP j)
    exact ae_restrict_of_ae this
  have hgood : ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict N), (∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P),
      HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (η x) Q) ∧
      ∀ i, x ∈ M i → (ξ' i x = η x ∨ ξ' i x = -η x) := by
    have hmemN : ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict N), x ∈ N := ae_restrict_mem hNmeas
    filter_upwards [hPN, hmemN] with x hx hxN
    rw [← hDunion] at hxN
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hxN
    obtain ⟨Qj, hQj1, hQj2⟩ := hx j (hDsub j hj)
    rw [← hη_eq j x hj] at hQj2

subproblems.title: An integer-valued density on an oriented rectifiable set gives an IMRep
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and U ⊆ ℝ^P open. Let N ⊆ U be Borel and countably n-rectifiable with Hⁿ(N ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U. Let η : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n) be strongly measurable. Let m : ℝ^P → ℝ be measurable with m(x) ∈ ℤ for every x and ∫_{N∩K} |m| dHⁿ < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U. Assume that for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ N there is a linear subspace Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x Q and IsUnitOrientationOf (η(x)) Q. Then there is an IMRep R in U such that R.action(ω) = ∫_N m(x)·η(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ(x) for every n-form ω : ℝ^P → Λⁿ(ℝ^P) (DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, no regularity required).
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (η : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (m : Euclid P → ℝ), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet N → N ⊆ U → CountablyRectifiable n N → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (N ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → StronglyMeasurable η → Measurable m → (∀ x, ∃ z : ℤ, m x = z) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∫⁻ x in N ∩ K, ‖m x‖ₑ ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict N), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (η x) Q) → ∃ R : IMRep U n, ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, R.action ω = ∫ x in N, m x * η x (ω x) ∂μHE[n]
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: steps (5e) and (5g) of the supplied proof: the IMRep (N', |m|, sign(m)η) built from an integer multiplicity m and an orientation η of N. Tangent planes pass from N to N' by locality, which is (IMC)(a), here the reused sibling tangent_locality. Stated for an arbitrary open U and degree n; the supplied proof's removal of a null set Z is unnecessary because the IMRep fields are a.e. conditions.

Notation: μ := Hⁿ = μHE[n].

1. (Carrier.) N' := N ∩ {x : m(x) ≠ 0}. It is Borel: N is Borel and m is measurable, so {m ≠ 0} = m⁻¹(ℝ ∖ {0}) is Borel. Also N' ⊆ N ⊆ U.
2. (Multiplicity.) mult(x) := ⌊|m(x)|⌋₊ ∈ ℕ (Nat.floor). For every x, m(x) = z for some z ∈ ℤ, and |m(x)| = |z| is the natural number natAbs z, so (mult(x) : ℝ) = |m(x)|. mult is measurable as the composition of the measurable m, the continuous |·| and the monotone, hence measurable, ⌊·⌋₊ : ℝ → ℕ (Monotone.measurable). For x ∈ N', m(x) ≠ 0, so mult(x) = |m(x)| > 0.
3. (Orientation.) orient(x) := −η(x) if m(x) < 0, and orient(x) := η(x) otherwise. It is strongly measurable: η and −η = (−1)•η are strongly measurable, {m < 0} is Borel, and the piecewise combination is strongly measurable (StronglyMeasurable.ite). In particular orient is a.e. strongly measurable for μ⌞N'.
4. (Rectifiability, local integrability.) N' ⊆ N, so N' is countably n-rectifiable (CountablyRectifiable.mono). For compact K ⊆ U: ∫_{N'∩K} mult dμ ≤ ∫_{N∩K} mult dμ = ∫_{N∩K} |m| dμ < ∞, by monotonicity in the set, step 2 and the hypothesis.
5. (Orientation field.) Apply sibling tangent_locality with open U, small set N' and large set N. Here N' ⊆ N ⊆ U are Borel and N is locally finite by hypothesis. So for μ⌞N'-a.e. x and every Q: HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x Q ⟺ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N' x Q. The hypothesis on η holds μ⌞N-a.e., hence μ⌞N'-a.e., since N' ⊆ N. Take x outside both exceptional null sets and Q from the hypothesis. Then HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N' x Q, and orient(x) ∈ {η(x), −η(x)} is a unit orientation of Q. Indeed, if η(x)(α) = α(τ) for all α (resp. −α(τ)), with τ orthonormal spanning Q, then −η(x)(α) = −α(τ) (resp. α(τ)); IsUnitOrientationOf allows either sign with the same τ.
6. Steps 1–5 verify every field of IMRep (measurableSet_carrier, carrier_subset, rectifiable, measurable_mult, mult_pos, locallyIntegrable_mult, aestronglyMeasurable_orient, orients). So R := (N', mult, orient) is an IMRep in U.
7. (Action.) Let ω be any n-form. For x ∈ N:
   - if m(x) = 0, then x ∉ N' and 1_{N'}(x)·mult(x)·orient(x)(ω(x)) = 0 = m(x)·η(x)(ω(x));
   - if m(x) ≠ 0, then x ∈ N' and mult(x)·orient(x)(ω(x)) = |m(x)|·(±η(x)(ω(x))) = m(x)·η(x)(ω(x)), the sign being that of m(x).
   So the functions 1_{N'}·mult·orient(ω) and m·η(ω) agree at every point of N. Hence R.action(ω) = ∫_{N'} mult·orient(ω) dμ = ∫_{N ∩ N'} mult·orient(ω) dμ (since N ∩ N' = N') = ∫_N 1_{N'}·mult·orient(ω) dμ (setIntegral_indicator) = ∫_N m·η(ω) dμ (setIntegral_congr_fun). No integrability is needed: Bochner integrals over N of functions that agree pointwise on N coincide. ∎

theorem Submission.cmcdt_ims_imrep_of_int_density : ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (η : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (m : Euclid P → ℝ), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet N → N ⊆ U → CountablyRectifiable n N → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (N ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → StronglyMeasurable η → Measurable m → (∀ x, ∃ z : ℤ, m x = z) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∫⁻ x in N ∩ K, ‖m x‖ₑ ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict N), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (η x) Q) → ∃ R : IMRep U n, ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, R.action ω = ∫ x in N, m x * η x (ω x) ∂μHE[n] := by
  intro P n U N η m hU hN hNU hrect hfin hη hm hint hloc hor
  classical
  -- the carrier
  set N' : Set (Euclid P) := N ∩ {x | m x ≠ 0} with hN'def
  have hN'meas : MeasurableSet N' :=
    hN.inter ((measurableSet_singleton (0 : ℝ)).preimage hm).compl
  have hN'N : N' ⊆ N := inter_subset_left
  -- multiplicity and orientation
  set mult : Euclid P → ℕ := fun x => ⌊|m x|⌋₊ with hmultdef
  set orient : Euclid P → MultiVector P n := fun x => if m x < 0 then -η x else η x with horientdef
  have hmult_cast : ∀ x, ((mult x : ℕ) : ℝ) = |m x| := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hint x
    simp only [hmultdef, hz]
    rw [show |(z : ℝ)| = ((z.natAbs : ℕ) : ℝ) by simp [Nat.cast_natAbs]]
    rw [Nat.floor_natCast]
  have hmult_meas : Measurable mult := (Nat.floor_mono.measurable).comp (continuous_abs.measurable.comp hm)
  have hmult_pos : ∀ x ∈ N', 0 < mult x := by
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : m x ≠ 0 := hx.2
    have h1 : (0 : ℝ) < ((mult x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      rw [hmult_cast]; exact abs_pos.mpr hx0
    exact_mod_cast h1
  have horient_sm : StronglyMeasurable orient := by
    have hset : MeasurableSet {x | m x < 0} := measurableSet_lt hm measurable_const
    have hneg : StronglyMeasurable (fun x => -η x) := by
      have := hη.const_smul (-1 : ℝ)
      convert this using 1
      funext x
      exact (neg_one_smul ℝ (η x)).symm
    exact StronglyMeasurable.ite hset hneg hη
  -- local integrability
  have hloc' : ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U →
      ∫⁻ x in N' ∩ K, (mult x : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞ := by
    intro K hK hKU
    refine ne_top_of_le_ne_top (hloc K hK hKU) ?_
    calc ∫⁻ x in N' ∩ K, (mult x : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n]
        ≤ ∫⁻ x in N ∩ K, (mult x : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n] :=
          lintegral_mono_set (inter_subset_inter_left _ hN'N)
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ x in N ∩ K, ‖m x‖ₑ ∂μHE[n] := by
          refine lintegral_mono fun x => ?_
          rw [Real.enorm_eq_ofReal_abs, ← hmult_cast x, ENNReal.ofReal_natCast]
  -- orientation
  have hor' : ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict N'), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P),
      HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N' x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (orient x) Q := by
    have h1 := Submission.rsdic_ae_tangent_iff_of_subset P n U N' N hU hN'meas hN hN'N hNU hfin
    have h2 : ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict N'), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P),
        HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (η x) Q :=
      ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset hN'N hor
    filter_upwards [h1, h2] with x hx1 hx2
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ1, hQ2⟩ := hx2
    refine ⟨Q, (hx1 Q).1 hQ1, ?_⟩
    simp only [horientdef]
    split_ifs
    · obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hspan, hξ⟩ := hQ2
      refine ⟨τ, hτ, hspan, ?_⟩
      rcases hξ with h | h
      · right; intro α; simp [h]
      · left; intro α; simp [h]
    · exact hQ2
  let R : IMRep U n :=
    { carrier := N'
      mult := mult
      orient := orient
      measurableSet_carrier := hN'meas
      carrier_subset := hN'N.trans hNU
      rectifiable := hrect.mono hN'N
      measurable_mult := hmult_meas
      mult_pos := hmult_pos
      locallyIntegrable_mult := hloc'
      aestronglyMeasurable_orient := horient_sm.aestronglyMeasurable
      orients := hor' }
  refine ⟨R, ?_⟩
  intro ω
  show ∫ x in N', (mult x : ℝ) * orient x (ω x) ∂μHE[n] = ∫ x in N, m x * η x (ω x) ∂μHE[n]
  have hpt : ∀ x ∈ N, N'.indicator (fun x => (mult x : ℝ) * orient x (ω x)) x = m x * η x (ω x) := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases hx0 : m x = 0
    · have : x ∉ N' := fun h => h.2 hx0
      simp [this, hx0]
    · have hxN' : x ∈ N' := ⟨hx, hx0⟩
      rw [indicator_of_mem hxN', hmult_cast]
      simp only [horientdef]
      split_ifs with hneg
      · rw [abs_of_neg hneg]; simp
      · rw [abs_of_nonneg (not_lt.mp hneg)]
  calc ∫ x in N', (mult x : ℝ) * orient x (ω x) ∂μHE[n]
      = ∫ x in N ∩ N', (mult x : ℝ) * orient x (ω x) ∂μHE[n] := by
        rw [inter_eq_right.mpr hN'N]
    _ = ∫ x in N, N'.indicator (fun x => (mult x : ℝ) * orient x (ω x)) x ∂μHE[n] :=
        (setIntegral_indicator hN'meas).symm
    _ = ∫ x in N, m x * η x (ω x) ∂μHE[n] := setIntegral_congr_fun hN hpt
proof_key_steps: Carrier N' := N ∩ {m ≠ 0} (Borel), multiplicity ⌊|m|⌋₊ = |m| (measurable, positive on N'), orientation sign(m)·η (strongly measurable).
N' ⊆ N gives rectifiability; ∫_{N'∩K} |m| ≤ ∫_{N∩K} |m| < ∞ gives local integrability.
tangent_locality for N' ⊆ N moves the oriented approximate tangent planes of N to N'; ±η(x) is still a unit orientation.
1_{N'}·|m|·sign(m)η(ω) = m·η(ω) pointwise on N, so R.action(ω) = ∫_N m·η(ω) dHⁿ for every form ω.

subproblems.title: A countable family of IMReps with finite total mass is represented by one IMRep
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and R_i = (M_i, θ_i, ξ_i) (i ∈ ℕ) IMReps in U with Σ_i μ_{R_i}(U) < ∞, where μ_R := θ·Hⁿ⌞M is IMRep.measure. Then there is an IMRep R' in U such that for every test form ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) the real series Σ_i R_i.action(ω) has sum R'.action(ω) (HasSum). Here R.action(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ(x).
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : ℕ → IMRep U n), IsOpen U → ∑' i, (R i).measure U ≠ ∞ → ∃ R' : IMRep U n, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, HasSum (fun i => (R i).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) (R'.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n))
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: step 5 of the supplied proof ((5a)–(5g)) at the level of IMReps. The parent applies this child to IMReps R_i of the W_i, after converting M(W_i) = μ_{R_i}(ℝ^P) by (MR). Steps (5c)–(5d) are the sibling common_orientation and step (5g) is the sibling density_imrep. Stated for an arbitrary open U and degree n. The integer density is the real tsum m = Σ'_i s_iθ_i1_{M_i}, which is 0 where the series does not converge; it is integer-valued everywhere, so no exceptional set has to be removed.

Notation: μ := Hⁿ = μHE[n]; M_i := R_i.carrier, θ_i := R_i.mult, ξ_i := R_i.orient; A := Σ_i μ_{R_i}(U) < ∞.

1. (Masses.) Θ_i := 1_{M_i}·θ_i is [0, ∞]-valued, finite and measurable. U is open, hence Borel, and M_i ⊆ U. So μ_{R_i}(U) = ∫_U θ_i d(μ⌞M_i) (withDensity_apply) = ∫_{M_i} θ_i dμ = ∫ Θ_i dμ (lintegral_indicator). Θ := Σ_i Θ_i is measurable, and ∫ Θ dμ = Σ_i ∫ Θ_i dμ = A < ∞ (lintegral_tsum).
2. (The union.) N := ⋃_i M_i is Borel, N ⊆ U, and N is countably n-rectifiable (SimonGMT countablyRectifiable_iUnion). Also μ(N) ≤ Σ_i μ(M_i) ≤ Σ_i ∫_{M_i} θ_i dμ = A, since θ_i ≥ 1 on M_i (mult_pos) gives μ(M_i) = ∫_{M_i} 1 ≤ ∫_{M_i} θ_i. Hence μ(N ∩ K) ≤ A < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U.
3. (Common orientation.) Apply sibling common_orientation to (R_i), with U open and the bound of step 2. It gives a strongly measurable η and measurable s_i with values in {1, −1} such that: (a) for μ⌞N-a.e. x there is Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x Q and IsUnitOrientationOf (η(x)) Q; (b) ξ_i = s_i·η μ-a.e. on M_i, for every i.
4. (The integer density.) a_i := 1_{M_i}·s_i·θ_i is real-valued and measurable. Since |s_i| = 1, |a_i| = Θ_i (as real numbers), and a_i(x) ∈ ℤ. Put m(x) := Σ'_i a_i(x), the real tsum, which is 0 when the series is not summable. m is measurable (Measurable.tsum).
   - m(x) ∈ ℤ for every x. If (a_i(x))_i is summable, then a_i(x) → 0 along the cofinite filter, so |a_i(x)| < 1 for all but finitely many i. For an integer this forces a_i(x) = 0 (Int.abs_lt_one_iff). So only finitely many terms are nonzero, and m(x) is a finite sum of integers (tsum_eq_sum). If the series is not summable, m(x) = 0.
   - ‖m(x)‖ₑ ≤ Σ_i ‖a_i(x)‖ₑ = Θ(x) for every x (enorm_tsum_le_tsum_enorm). Hence ∫_{N∩K} |m| dμ ≤ ∫ Θ dμ = A < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U.
5. (The IMRep.) Steps 2–4 and 3(a) are exactly the hypotheses of sibling density_imrep for (U, N, η, m). It gives an IMRep R' in U with R'.action(ω) = ∫_N m(x)·η(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for every n-form ω.
6. (Dominated convergence.) Fix ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U); it is continuous with compact support, so there is B ≥ 0 with ‖ω(x)‖ ≤ B for all x (HasCompactSupport.exists_bound_of_continuous). The map x ↦ η(x)(ω(x)) is strongly measurable: it is the image of the strongly measurable pair x ↦ (η(x), x) under the continuous map (ξ, y) ↦ ξ(ω(y)) (isBoundedBilinearMap_apply). By 3(a) and sibling orient_norm, ‖η(x)‖ ≤ 1 for μ⌞N-a.e. x, so there |η(x)(ω(x))| ≤ ‖η(x)‖·‖ω(x)‖ ≤ B. On the measure space (ℝ^P, μ⌞N) put F_i(x) := a_i(x)·η(x)(ω(x)) and b_i(x) := B·Θ_i(x)^ℝ. Then:
   - each F_i is a.e. strongly measurable;
   - |F_i| ≤ b_i a.e.;
   - since ∫ Θ dμ < ∞, Θ < ∞ μ-a.e. (ae_lt_top), so (b_i(x))_i is summable for a.e. x (ENNReal.summable_toReal);
   - x ↦ Σ'_i b_i(x) is measurable with ∫ ‖Σ'_i b_i‖ₑ d(μ⌞N) ≤ ‖B‖ₑ·∫ Θ dμ < ∞, hence integrable;
   - where Θ(x) < ∞, (a_i(x)) is summable (|a_i(x)| = Θ_i(x)^ℝ), so HasSum (i ↦ F_i(x)) (m(x)·η(x)(ω(x))).
   The dominated convergence theorem for series (hasSum_integral_of_dominated_convergence) gives HasSum (i ↦ ∫_N F_i dμ) (∫_N m·η(ω) dμ).
7. (Identification of the terms.) Fix i. By 3(b), for μ-a.e. x ∈ M_i, θ_i(x)·ξ_i(x)(ω(x)) = θ_i(x)·s_i(x)·η(x)(ω(x)). So R_i.action(ω) = ∫_{M_i} θ_i·ξ_i(ω) dμ = ∫_{M_i} s_i·θ_i·η(ω) dμ (setIntegral_congr_ae). Since M_i ⊆ N, this equals ∫_{N ∩ M_i} s_i·θ_i·η(ω) dμ = ∫_N 1_{M_i}·s_i·θ_i·η(ω) dμ (setIntegral_indicator) = ∫_N F_i dμ.
8. By steps 5–7, HasSum (i ↦ R_i.action(ω)) (R'.action(ω)) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). ∎

  have hΘi_ne_top : ∀ i x, Θi i x ≠ ∞ := by
    intro i x
    simp only [hΘidef]
    by_cases hx : x ∈ M i
    · rw [indicator_of_mem hx]; exact ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _
    · rw [indicator_of_notMem hx]; exact ENNReal.zero_ne_top
  have hmeasU : ∀ i, (R i).measure U = ∫⁻ x, Θi i x ∂μHE[n] := by
    intro i
    simp only [IMRep.measure, hΘidef]
    rw [withDensity_apply _ hU.measurableSet, Measure.restrict_restrict hU.measurableSet,
      inter_eq_right.mpr (R i).carrier_subset, lintegral_indicator (hMmeas i)]
  set Θ : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞ := fun x => ∑' i, Θi i x with hΘdef
  have hΘ_meas : Measurable Θ := Measurable.ennreal_tsum hΘi_meas
  have hΘ_int : ∫⁻ x, Θ x ∂μHE[n] = ∑' i, (R i).measure U := by
    rw [lintegral_tsum (fun i => (hΘi_meas i).aemeasurable)]
    simp_rw [hmeasU]
  have hΘ_fin : ∫⁻ x, Θ x ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞ := hΘ_int ▸ hA
  -- Step 2: `Hⁿ(N) ≤ Σ μ_{R_i}(U)`
  have hN_le : μHE[n] N ≤ ∑' i, (R i).measure U := by
    refine (measure_iUnion_le M).trans (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun i => ?_)
    rw [hmeasU i, hΘidef]
    simp only
    rw [lintegral_indicator (hMmeas i), ← setLIntegral_one]
    refine setLIntegral_mono' (hMmeas i) fun x hx => ?_
    have := (R i).mult_pos x hx
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hNfin : ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (N ∩ K) ≠ ∞ := by
    intro K _ _
    exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top hA ((measure_mono inter_subset_left).trans hN_le)
  -- Step 3: the common orientation
  obtain ⟨η, s, hη, hs_meas, hs_val, hor, hrel⟩ := Submission.cmcdt_ims_common_orientation P n U R hU hNfin
  -- Step 4: the integer density `m = Σ sᵢ θᵢ 1_{Mᵢ}`
  set a : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ := fun i => (M i).indicator (fun y => s i y * ((R i).mult y : ℝ))
    with hadef
  have ha_meas : ∀ i, Measurable (a i) := fun i =>
    ((hs_meas i).mul (measurable_from_nat.comp (R i).measurable_mult)).indicator (hMmeas i)
  have ha_norm : ∀ i x, ‖a i x‖ = (Θi i x).toReal := by
    intro i x
    simp only [hadef, hΘidef]
    by_cases hx : x ∈ M i
    · rw [indicator_of_mem hx, indicator_of_mem hx]
      rcases hs_val i x with h | h <;> simp [h]
    · rw [indicator_of_notMem hx, indicator_of_notMem hx]; simp
  have ha_enorm : ∀ i x, ‖a i x‖ₑ = Θi i x := by
    intro i x
    rw [← ofReal_norm_eq_enorm, ha_norm, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (hΘi_ne_top i x)]
  have ha_int : ∀ i x, ∃ z : ℤ, a i x = z := by
    intro i x
    simp only [hadef]
    by_cases hx : x ∈ M i
    · rw [indicator_of_mem hx]
      rcases hs_val i x with h | h
      · exact ⟨(R i).mult x, by simp [h]⟩
      · exact ⟨-((R i).mult x : ℤ), by simp [h]⟩
    · exact ⟨0, by simp [indicator_of_notMem hx]⟩
  choose z hz using ha_int
  set m : Euclid P → ℝ := fun x => ∑' i, a i x with hmdef
  have hm_meas : Measurable m := Measurable.tsum ha_meas
  have hm_int : ∀ x, ∃ k : ℤ, m x = k := by
    intro x
    by_cases hsum : Summable (fun i => a i x)
    · have hfin : {i | a i x ≠ 0}.Finite := by
        have ht := hsum.tendsto_cofinite_zero
        have hev : ∀ᶠ i in cofinite, a i x ∈ ball (0 : ℝ) 1 := ht (ball_mem_nhds 0 one_pos)
        refine (Filter.eventually_cofinite.mp hev).subset fun i hi => ?_
        simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hi ⊢
        intro hlt
        apply hi
        rw [hz i x] at hlt ⊢
        have : z i x = 0 := by
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hlt
          have h1 : |(z i x : ℝ)| < 1 := hlt
          have h2 : |z i x| < 1 := by exact_mod_cast h1
          exact Int.abs_lt_one_iff.mp h2
        simp [this]
      refine ⟨∑ i ∈ hfin.toFinset, z i x, ?_⟩
      simp only [hmdef]
      rw [tsum_eq_sum (s := hfin.toFinset) (fun i hi => by simpa using hi)]
      push_cast
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hz i x
    · exact ⟨0, by simp [hmdef, tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable hsum]⟩
  have hm_le : ∀ x, ‖m x‖ₑ ≤ Θ x := by
    intro x
    calc ‖m x‖ₑ ≤ ∑' i, ‖a i x‖ₑ := enorm_tsum_le_tsum_enorm
      _ = Θ x := by simp only [hΘdef, ha_enorm]
  have hloc : ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U →
      ∫⁻ x in N ∩ K, ‖m x‖ₑ ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞ := by
    intro K _ _
    refine ne_top_of_le_ne_top hΘ_fin ?_
    exact (setLIntegral_le_lintegral _ _).trans (lintegral_mono hm_le)
  have hrect : CountablyRectifiable n N :=
    Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.countablyRectifiable_iUnion M fun i => (R i).rectifiable
  -- Step 5: the representing IMRep of `(N, m, η)`
  obtain ⟨R', hR'⟩ := Submission.cmcdt_ims_imrep_of_int_density P n U N η m hU hNmeas hNU hrect hNfin hη hm_meas hm_int hloc hor
  refine ⟨R', fun ω => ?_⟩
  -- Step 6: dominated convergence for the series
  have hsmooth : IsSmoothForm (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) := ω.property.1.1
  have hωc : Continuous (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) := ContDiff.continuous hsmooth
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := HasCompactSupport.exists_bound_of_continuous ω.property.1.2 hωc
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hB 0)
  have hev_sm : StronglyMeasurable (fun x => η x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x)) := by
    have hcont : Continuous (fun p : MultiVector P n × Euclid P =>
        p.1 ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) p.2)) :=
      isBoundedBilinearMap_apply.continuous.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk (hωc.comp continuous_snd))
    exact hcont.comp_stronglyMeasurable (hη.prodMk stronglyMeasurable_id)
  set F : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ := fun i x => a i x * η x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x)
    with hFdef
  set bound : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ := fun i x => B * (Θi i x).toReal with hbounddef
  have hF_sm : ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable (F i) (μHE[n].restrict N) := fun i =>
    ((ha_meas i).stronglyMeasurable.mul hev_sm).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hηnorm : ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict N), ‖η x‖ ≤ 1 := by
    filter_upwards [hor] with x hx
    obtain ⟨Q, -, hQ⟩ := hx
    exact Submission.unit_orientation_norm_le_one P n Q (η x) hQ
  have hF_le : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict N), ‖F i x‖ ≤ bound i x := by
    intro i
    filter_upwards [hηnorm] with x hx
    simp only [hFdef, hbounddef, norm_mul, ha_norm]
    have h1 : ‖η x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x)‖ ≤ B := by
      calc ‖η x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x)‖
          ≤ ‖η x‖ * ‖(ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x‖ := (η x).le_opNorm _
        _ ≤ 1 * B := mul_le_mul hx (hB x) (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = B := one_mul B
    calc (Θi i x).toReal * ‖η x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x)‖
        ≤ (Θi i x).toReal * B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
      _ = B * (Θi i x).toReal := mul_comm _ _
  have hΘ_lt : ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict N), Θ x < ∞ :=
    ae_restrict_of_ae (ae_lt_top hΘ_meas hΘ_fin)
  have hsumΘ : ∀ x, Θ x < ∞ → Summable (fun i => (Θi i x).toReal) :=
    fun x hx => ENNReal.summable_toReal hx.ne
  have hbound_sum : ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict N), Summable (fun i => bound i x) := by
    filter_upwards [hΘ_lt] with x hx
    exact (hsumΘ x hx).mul_left B
  have hbound_int : Integrable (fun x => ∑' i, bound i x) (μHE[n].restrict N) := by
    have hmeas : Measurable (fun x => ∑' i, bound i x) :=
      Measurable.tsum fun i => measurable_const.mul (hΘi_meas i).ennreal_toReal
    refine ⟨hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable, ?_⟩
    have hle : ∀ x, ‖∑' i, bound i x‖ₑ ≤ ‖B‖ₑ * Θ x := by
      intro x
      calc ‖∑' i, bound i x‖ₑ ≤ ∑' i, ‖bound i x‖ₑ := enorm_tsum_le_tsum_enorm
        _ = ∑' i, ‖B‖ₑ * Θi i x := by
            congr 1; funext i
            simp only [hbounddef]
            rw [enorm_mul, ← ofReal_norm_eq_enorm (Θi i x).toReal, Real.norm_eq_abs,
              abs_of_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (hΘi_ne_top i x)]
        _ = ‖B‖ₑ * Θ x := ENNReal.tsum_mul_left
    calc ∫⁻ x, ‖∑' i, bound i x‖ₑ ∂(μHE[n].restrict N)
        ≤ ∫⁻ x, ‖B‖ₑ * Θ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict N) := lintegral_mono hle
      _ = ‖B‖ₑ * ∫⁻ x, Θ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict N) := lintegral_const_mul _ hΘ_meas
      _ ≤ ‖B‖ₑ * ∫⁻ x, Θ x ∂μHE[n] := by gcongr; exact Measure.restrict_le_self
      _ < ∞ := ENNReal.mul_lt_top enorm_lt_top hΘ_fin.lt_top
  have hF_sum : ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict N),
      HasSum (fun i => F i x) (m x * η x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x)) := by
    filter_upwards [hΘ_lt] with x hx
    have hs : Summable (fun i => a i x) :=
      Summable.of_norm_bounded (hsumΘ x hx) fun i => (ha_norm i x).le
    exact hs.hasSum.mul_right _
  have hmain := hasSum_integral_of_dominated_convergence bound hF_sm hF_le hbound_sum hbound_int hF_sum
  -- Step 7: identify the terms and the sum
  have hterm : ∀ i, ∫ x, F i x ∂(μHE[n].restrict N) = (R i).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) := by
    intro i
    have h1 : ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (M i)),
        ((R i).mult x : ℝ) * (R i).orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) =
          s i x * ((R i).mult x : ℝ) * η x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) := by
      filter_upwards [hrel i] with x hx
      rw [hx, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have h2 : ∀ x, F i x = (M i).indicator (fun y => s i y * ((R i).mult y : ℝ) *
        η y ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y)) x := by
      intro x
      simp only [hFdef, hadef]
      by_cases hx : x ∈ M i
      · rw [indicator_of_mem hx, indicator_of_mem hx]
      · rw [indicator_of_notMem hx, indicator_of_notMem hx, zero_mul]
    simp only [IMRep.action]
    rw [setIntegral_congr_ae (hMmeas i) ((ae_restrict_iff' (hMmeas i)).mp h1)]
    simp_rw [h2]
    rw [setIntegral_indicator (hMmeas i), inter_eq_right.mpr (subset_iUnion M i)]
  simp_rw [hterm] at hmain
  rw [hR' (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)]
  exact hmain
proof_key_steps: μ_{R_i}(U) = ∫ θ_i1_{M_i} dHⁿ, so Θ := Σ_i θ_i1_{M_i} has ∫ Θ = A < ∞ and Hⁿ(N) ≤ A for N := ⋃ M_i (θ_i ≥ 1 on M_i).
common_orientation gives a strongly measurable η orienting the approximate tangent planes of N a.e., and signs s_i with ξ_i = s_iη a.e. on M_i.

m := Σ'_i s_iθ_i1_{M_i} is measurable, integer-valued everywhere (a summable integer series has finitely many nonzero terms), and |m| ≤ Θ; density_imrep turns (N, m, η) into an IMRep R' with R'.action(ω) = ∫_N mη(ω).
With ‖η‖ ≤ 1 a.e. (orient_norm) and ‖ω‖ ≤ B, dominated convergence for series gives Σ_i ∫_N 1_{M_i}s_iθ_iη(ω) = ∫_N mη(ω).
Each term equals R_i.action(ω) because ξ_i = s_iη a.e. on M_i; hence HasSum (R_i.action ω) (R'.action ω).
